content:
kelly_ae: Heads up — procurement at Acme flagged us. They say our Marketplace billing doesn't meet their PO requirements; they want consolidated monthly invoice + net30. The marketplace path forces charges per-transaction to reseller. Need options before EOD. cc @naveen_saleseng @maria_finance
naveen_saleseng: On it. Is this for the 3-month POC commit or the annual reserved commit? POC is usually marketplace-friendly.
kelly_ae: POC: 3mo, target commit $35k. Customer wants invoice to their AP team (PO# 6789) not via marketplace billing entity. Procurement says 'no marketplace charges to third party'.
maria_finance: This is a common mismatch. Marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) invoices go through partner/reseller flows and appear on their platform's invoice => customer accounting can't accept. If they insist on direct invoice, we need a special ARR SOW + billing override with finance approval.
procurement_tom: Procurement is unwilling to accept any passthrough. They require (a) Redwood invoice to their legal entity, (b) PO matching on invoice, (c) 30-day payment term. They also want line-item SKUs.
naveen_saleseng: Two options: (1) Direct-sell: short SOW + net30 invoice (Redwood invoices directly). Requires deal desk + finance signoff for rate override. (2) Marketplace: customer buys via CSP, we reconcile later with credit memos — messy.
dealdesk_bot: :thinking_face: DealDesk queue created: DD-9981. Need rate override form, list of SKUs, expected ARR recognition, and reason 'procurement billing path required'.
kelly_ae: Customer needs answer before procurement window closes (72 hours). Can we get Deal Desk decision today for 10% marketplace discount + direct invoice for POC only?
naveen_saleseng: I can assemble pricing grid. Proposed: POC commit $35k, list price $0.20/token => discounted to effective $0.17/token for POC; Redwood invoices net30. Confirm recognition terms with finance.
maria_finance: Finance OK in principle for POC-only direct invoice if revenue recog is handled as deferred until service delivery. Need GL codes and cost-center mapping. Send invoice example.
kelly_ae: Uploaded: Acme_PO_6789.pdf (attached)
procurement_tom: If we go direct-sell, we need a marketplace credit note and proof that charges were removed from their CSP bill.
naveen_saleseng: Plan B: If Deal Desk denies override, offer dual-path: customer buys minimal base via marketplace to satisfy CSP procurement, Redwood issues direct invoice for committed overage and applies credit. That should satisfy both.
legal_maya: I'll prep the SOW template, need to know if customer requires any data residency/KMS clause. Any special security requirements?
kelly_ae: Acme requires SOC2 + customer-managed keys for POC data. Will send security questionnaire answers.
procurement_tom: Procurement also flagged that their AP system can't ingest marketplace SKUs (format mismatch). They prefer simple invoice with 3 lines: POC fee, support, and discount.
dealdesk_bot: DD-9981 updated: requested docs attached. ETA for review 6 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
naveen_saleseng: :thumbsup: I'll ping SalesOps to prefill rate override form and CPQ lines:
```
SKU,Description,Qty,UnitPrice,Total
R-INF-POC-3M,POC Commit (3mo),1,$35,000,$35,000
R-INF-SUP-POC,Support (3mo),1,$5,000,$5,000
R-DISC-POC,POC discount,-1,$4,000,-$4,000
```
maria_finance: Looks good. Once Deal Desk approves, finance will generate net30 invoice referencing PO#6789.
kelly_ae: Customer scheduled kickoff Wed. If we don't resolve billing path they'll pause POC. Please prioritize.
naveen_saleseng: I'll escalate to director of SalesOps if we don't get Deal Desk green in 4hrs. @dealdesk_bot please notify.
dealdesk_bot: Notified DD team and Sales leadership. Thread will be closed after approval or 24h. :white_check_mark:
